Resources & advice

Documents & diagrams

Use this page to consult ideas and sources, develop a practice, or explore relationships through diagrams. The philosophy section already supplies the sequential reading route.

Views and three reading paths

Philosophy develops worldview, psychology investigates feeling and knowing, and engineering connects method with realization. Enter original sources by question and let these contributions revise one another through work; tool entrances separately provide usable Skills.

  • Core views

    Find the main claims together, organized by topic.

  • Philosophical readings

    Trace thinkers and works to their role in the argument and their original sources.

  • Psychological readings

    Books and papers on psychological process modeling and evidence, mind and psychological theories, belief, reasoning, and interaction.

  • Engineering readings

    From CS DIY and Missing Semester to Git, Linux, software design, algorithms, experimental implementation, and physical conditions.

Develop a practice

Begin with your own questions and give understanding a usable, revisable form.

  • Creation and realization

    See how personal philosophy, the counterpart relation, and an actual environment develop together.

  • Shared Skills and personal philosophy

    Distinguish reusable shared material from personal content, and understand adoption and maintenance.

Explore the relations
